item.title: Monday 4 PM Update, Nov 23
item.description:
The Monday four o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 23, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather for the next 24 hours; President Trump pauses the Army's planned detonation in Iowa, fourteen Republican attorneys general join the fight over Newsom's death row commutations, and a Princeton neuroscience student is held by immigration authorities; the EU proposes its twenty-second Russia sanctions package, Germany weighs reports of a Russian nuclear satellite, and Iran flogs a singer who performed without a hijab; the closing bell on Wall Street's biggest day since April 2025; Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia headquarters and a trade blacklist for Megaspeed; Catholic bishops push for AI rules and an AI agent fleet takes on P versus NP; Microsoft warns of stolen Azure credentials; your X feed; a New Hampshire Supreme Court retirement and Operation Santa Claus; and Jimmy Stewart's daughter in his hometown. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
